metadata.title: Fluentd AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from Fluentd Governance Benchmark

components.title: Fluentd
components.description: AI/ML component for Fluentd with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure collected logs are scanned for PII before forwarding to downstream stores

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Fluentd filters or parser stages to detect and tag records containing personal data before they are routed to storage, analytics, or AI systems.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: PII leakage rate, PII precision, PII recall

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = forwarded records containing seeded PII / total seeded PII test records. Precision and recall are computed for the configured PII detection or masking logic.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and PII detection recall remains above threshold for all monitored Fluentd pipelines.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Fluentd is not the detector itself, but it is a practical enforcement and transformation point where privacy checks and routing decisions can be applied.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure confidential fields are redacted or masked before output delivery

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Apply Fluentd record transformation or filtering so secrets, credentials, tokens, or internal business-sensitive fields are masked before logs leave the collection pipeline.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Exposure rate = output records containing seeded confidential tokens after masking / total seeded confidential test records.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure confidential-field exposure rate remains below threshold for all approved Fluentd routes.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This maps best to leakage-style metrics because Hugging Face model cards do not consistently publish dedicated confidential-data exposure metrics.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure parser success rate meets the approved minimum before logs are accepted for downstream use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate Fluentd parsers for all supported input formats so malformed, truncated, or misparsed records do not corrupt downstream analytics or AI datasets.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Parse success rate, parse error rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Parse success rate = successfully parsed records / total ingested records. Parse error rate = failed parses / total ingested records over the measurement window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure parser success rate remains above threshold and parse error rate remains below threshold for each supported source format.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Fluentd is directly responsible for parsing integrity, which affects downstream data trustworthiness but is not a Hugging Face model-card metric.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure schema conformance is validated for every structured log source

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Check incoming structured records against the approved field schema so added, missing, or type-mismatched fields are detected before downstream consumption.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Schema conformance rate, field-type mismatch rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Schema conformance = records matching approved schema / total structured records. Type mismatch rate = records with type violations / total structured records.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure schema conformance remains above threshold and field-type mismatch rate remains below threshold for all governed sources.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Schema drift is a central data-pipeline risk for Fluentd because it transforms and routes logs from heterogeneous sources.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure input-side log loss is monitored and stays below the approved threshold

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Fluentd buffer, retry, and delivery telemetry to detect dropped or unaccepted records during ingestion before they impact downstream evidence or AI datasets.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Log loss rate, ingest success rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Log loss rate = dropped or missing ingested records / total expected ingested records. Ingest success rate = accepted records / total offered records.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure log loss rate remains below threshold and ingest success rate remains above threshold across all production collectors.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Reliable ingestion is one of Fluentdâ€™s primary operational responsibilities and is foundational for audit and analytics integrity.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure buffer utilization and overflow events are monitored for every output path

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track buffer occupancy, queue length, flush delay, and overflow events so backpressure or downstream slowness does not silently cause record loss.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Buffer utilization, overflow event rate, flush latency

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Buffer utilization = used buffer capacity / total configured capacity. Overflow event rate = overflow incidents / total measurement intervals. Flush latency = end-to-end flush delay.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure overflow event rate remains at zero and flush latency stays within the approved operational threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a core Fluentd reliability control because buffering is central to its architecture.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure output delivery success rate meets the approved minimum for every destination

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Monitor retries, acknowledgments, and failed deliveries for every sink so Fluentd routing issues do not create silent gaps in downstream data stores.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Delivery success rate, retry rate, failed-delivery rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Delivery success rate = successfully delivered records / total records sent to destination. Retry rate = retried deliveries / total deliveries.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure delivery success rate remains above threshold and failed-delivery rate remains below threshold for each configured output.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Fluentdâ€™s output layer is a natural control point for measuring end-to-end delivery integrity.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure filtered and transformed records preserve approved field semantics

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that record transformation, field removal, renaming, and enrichment do not corrupt timestamps, identifiers, severity levels, or required business fields.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Transformation correctness = transformed records matching expected reference output / total tested transformed records. Field preservation = required fields preserved correctly / total required fields.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure transformation correctness and required-field preservation remain above threshold for all governed filters.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Exact-match style metrics are the closest HF-aligned analogue for reference-output validation of transformed records.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved Fluentd plugins are deployed in production pipelines

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict production deployment to vetted input, filter, buffer, parser, and output plugins whose versions and provenance are documented and approved.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Approved-plugin deployment rate = production pipelines using only approved plugins / total production pipelines.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure all production Fluentd pipelines use only approved plugins and approved plugin versions.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Fluentdâ€™s plugin-driven architecture creates a strong supply-chain and configuration-governance requirement.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure protected log transport is used for governed sources and destinations

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use transport security and authenticated endpoints for sensitive Fluentd paths so records are not exposed during forwarding or aggregation.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed Fluentd routes using approved protected transport / total governed routes in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure protected transport coverage reaches threshold for all governed routes carrying sensitive logs.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a pipeline security control rather than an AI-model metric, but it is essential where logs contain regulated or sensitive data.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure sensitive log retention behavior is aligned to the approved retention policy

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that Fluentd buffering, local persistence, retries, and downstream routing do not retain sensitive records beyond the approved lifecycle.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = sensitive records handled according to approved retention policy / total sensitive records sampled in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure retention-policy compliance remains at the required threshold for all sensitive log flows.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Because Fluentd can buffer and persist records temporarily, retention alignment is a realistic governance concern.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure timestamp parsing and normalization are correct across all supported time formats

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate time parsing logic so timezone offsets, format conversions, and missing time fields do not corrupt event sequencing or downstream analytics.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Timestamp correctness rate, time-parse error rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Timestamp correctness = records with correctly normalized timestamps / total tested records. Time-parse error rate = timestamp parse failures / total records with timestamps.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure timestamp correctness remains above threshold and time-parse error rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Timestamp correctness is critical because Fluentd often standardizes logs from heterogeneous sources.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure duplicate-record rate is measured for ingestion and retry paths

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track duplicate records caused by retries, upstream replay, or multi-path collection so downstream analytics and model-training datasets are not inflated.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Duplicate-record rate = duplicate records detected / total ingested records over the measurement window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure duplicate-record rate remains below threshold for all production collectors and retry paths.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is particularly important where Fluentd retries or multi-hop routing can unintentionally replay records.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure route-selection accuracy is validated for tag and match rules

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Test tag routing, match conditions, and label-based flows so records are delivered only to the intended downstream destinations.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Route-selection accuracy = records delivered to intended destination / total tested records across routing scenarios.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure route-selection accuracy remains above threshold for all governed routing rules.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Reference-output style validation is the closest analogue because routing correctness is deterministic and testable.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure forwarding occurs only to approved output destinations

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict production outputs to approved endpoints and verify that no logs are forwarded to unauthorized destinations or shadow sinks.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Approved-destination forwarding rate = records sent only to approved destinations / total routed records in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure all governed records are forwarded only to approved destinations.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a critical control where logs may contain sensitive operational, business, or user data.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure restart and failover scenarios preserve buffered records within approved limits

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Test Fluentd restart, crash, and failover behavior so buffered records are preserved and replayed correctly within the approved recovery window.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Recovery success rate, restart-related loss rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Recovery success = preserved and correctly delivered buffered records / total buffered records before restart. Restart-related loss rate = lost buffered records / buffered records before restart.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure restart-related loss remains below threshold and recovery success remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Buffer durability and recovery behavior are central to Fluentdâ€™s role as a reliable log pipeline.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: LLM or AI output logs containing harmful text

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxic AI-generated text in logs is measurable for governed monitoring pipelines

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where Fluentd handles logs containing AI prompts or outputs, log-safety analysis should measure toxicity trends before downstream storage or review.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Toxic-log rate = logged AI outputs exceeding toxicity threshold / total AI-output log records in the monitored sample.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure toxic-log rate and average toxicity remain below approved limits where Fluentd is used to transport AI outputs.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This rule only applies when Fluentd transports or archives AI-generated content rather than ordinary infrastructure logs.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure log collection coverage does not materially underrepresent required populations or event categories

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Measure whether collection rules, filters, or rate limits underrepresent required user groups, regions, event classes, or operational scenarios in downstream datasets.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage ratio = collected events for subgroup / expected subgroup events. Sampling disparity = max subgroup coverage difference across required groups.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup collection coverage remains within approved representativeness thresholds for governed datasets.

props.name: Threshold_Value
props.value: No subgroup below 80% of expected coverage

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Fluentd can shape downstream datasets through filtering and sampling, so representativeness can become a real data-governance concern.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure end-to-end log processing latency stays within the approved service objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track pipeline latency from input receipt to output delivery so Fluentd filtering, buffering, and output backpressure do not break timeliness requirements.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: End-to-end latency = output delivery timestamp - input receipt timestamp. Compute p95 latency over the observation window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 end-to-end processing latency remains within the approved service objective.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Latency matters when logs are used for near-real-time analytics, detection, or AI workflows.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every production pipeline has documented source-to-destination lineage

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Maintain lineage from input source through parser, filter, buffer, and output destination so reviewers can understand how records are transformed and routed.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = production pipelines with fully documented source, parser, filter, buffer, and destination lineage / total production pipelines.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure complete pipeline lineage exists for all production Fluentd pipelines.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This maps conceptually to completeness-style documentation metrics rather than a native HF model metric.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure filter and transformation logic is documented and test-backed

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document transformation purpose, affected fields, expected outputs, and validation evidence so record changes are explainable during review or incident investigation.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = documented required transformation fields and linked test evidence / total required documentation elements for each filter.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure transformation-documentation completeness reaches the required threshold for all governed filters.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is especially important when filtering changes records used later for compliance, analytics, or AI training.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Fluentd validation covers privacy, parsing, routing, reliability, and retention domains

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a Fluentd validation standard that tests privacy leakage, parser accuracy, schema conformance, routing correctness, buffering, restart recovery, and destination delivery instead of checking only pipeline uptime.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated Fluentd risk domains with active tests / total mandated risk domains in the validation standard.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Fluentd risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a governance rule that translates the benchmark approach into a log-pipeline context.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure pipeline architecture and dependency assumptions are documented

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document source systems, plugin versions, buffer modes, retry behavior, storage assumptions, output destinations, and operational dependencies for each governed pipeline.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = documented required architecture and dependency fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness is 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Even though Fluentd is not a model system, transparency is still needed for auditability and controlled operations.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure plugin provenance, version, and approval status are recorded

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Track the origin, version, support status, and approval state of every plugin used in governed Fluentd deployments.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = plugins with complete provenance, version, and approval metadata / total plugins in governed deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure plugin transparency completeness reaches 100% for all governed Fluentd deployments.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The plugin ecosystem is a central operational and security consideration for Fluentd.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for Fluentd
